p0.original: 关键问题：心理过程如何塑造我们的人格
p0.en: Critical issue: How the psychological process shapes our personality

p2.original: 尽管每一种人格过程理论都强调人格发展过程中的不同塑造力量，但是也都会把人格描述为内部心理过程和社会交互的结果。
p2.en: While each personality process theory emphasizes different shaping forces in the process of personality development, it is also described as the result of internal psychological processes and social interactions.

p3.original: 在本章后续部分，我们将以玛丽·卡尔金斯的个案研究作为范例来阐释各种人格理论。要理解卡尔金斯人格特质背后的心理力量，我们必须借助那些探究塑造人格的心理过程的人格理论。换句话说，我们必须超越我们之前介绍的静态特质、类型和气质等简单的标签，尝试理解人格是如何发展的。我们将介绍四种“过程”理论：心理动力学理论、人本主义理论、存在主义理论和社会认知理论。这些理论有什么共同点呢？请参考本阶段的核心概念：
p3.en: In the follow-up to this chapter, we will use the case study of Mary Carlkins as an example of the various personality theories. To understand the psychological power behind the character of Carlkins, we must build on the theory of personality that explores the psychological processes that shape it. In other words, we have to go beyond the simple labels of static features, types and air that we have described before and try to understand how the human personality develops. We will present four “process” theories: psychodynamics, humanism, existentialism and social awareness. What do these theories have in common? Please refer to the core concepts at this stage:

p4.original: 尽管每一种人格过程理论都强调人格发展过程中的不同塑造力量，但是也都会把人格描述为内部心理过程和社会交互的结果。
p4.en: While each personality process theory emphasizes different shaping forces in the process of personality development, it is also described as the result of internal psychological processes and social interactions.

p5.original: 虽然本节介绍的四种理论有一些共同点，但每一种理论强调的重点都是不同特质的组合。
p5.en: While the four theories presented in this section have some common elements, each theory emphasizes a combination of different characteristics.

p6.original: 1. 心理动力学理论（psychodynamic theory）关注无意识动机和过去的经验（特别是童年早期经验）对心理健康的影响。
p6.en: 1. The psychodynamic theory (psychodynamic theory) focuses on the impact of unconscious motivations and past experiences (especially early childhood experiences) on mental health.

p7.original: 2. 人本主义理论（humanistic theory）强调意识和我们对当前现实的主观看法：哪些是当下重要并能帮助我们成为最好的自己的天赋，以及如何看待自己与他人的关系。
p7.en: 2. The humanist theory emphasizes awareness and our subjective view of current realities: what is important now and can help us to be the best of our own talents, and how we view our relationship with others.

p8.original: 3. 存在主义理论（existential theory）试图把现在和理想未来联系起来，寻找个体存在的意义及生活的目标和意义。
p8.en: 3. The existentialist theory seeks to link the present with the ideal future in the search for the meaning of the individual's existence and the purpose and meaning of life.

p9.original: 4. 社会认知理论（social-cognitive theory）关注学习、感知和社会互动对我们当前行为的综合影响，无论是好的还是坏的。
p9.en: 4. Social-cognitive theory focuses on the combined effects of learning, perception and social interaction on our current behaviour, be it good or bad.

p18.original: 比较各种人格的心理动力学理论。

p19.original: 心理动力学理论起源于19世纪晚期一个被称为癔症（hysteria）的医学难题，现在被称为转换障碍（conversion disorder）。对于这种障碍的患者，医生会观察到一系列躯体症状，如肌肉无力、部分身体失去知觉，甚至瘫痪，但没有明显的生理原因（如神经损伤）。直到法国医生让·沙尔科（Jean Charcot）通过催眠使癔症症状消失时，人们才终于清楚了解了癔症的心理本质。
p19.en: The psychodynamic theory, which originated in the late nineteenth century in a medical problem known as hysteria, is now known as conversion disorder. For patients with such disorders, doctors observe a range of physical symptoms, such as muscle incompetence, partial body loss of consciousness, or even paralysis, without obvious physical causes (such as neurological damage). It was not until the French doctor Jean Charcot had hypnotized the symptoms of the disease, that the psychological nature of the disease was finally understood.

p21.original: 听说了沙尔科的工作后，好奇的年轻医生西格蒙德·弗洛伊德（Sigmund Freud，1856—1939）来到巴黎近距离地观察沙尔科著名的催眠演示。深受鼓舞的弗洛伊德回到了维也纳，决心在自己的病人身上尝试催眠疗法。但令弗洛伊德博士沮丧的是，他发现自己无法对许多人进行足够深度的催眠以复制沙尔科的结果。他不知道人们对催眠的感受性有很大不同，即每个人接受催眠师暗示的能力是有差别的。此外，即使是那些在催眠状态下症状消失的人，通常也会在催眠状态解除后恢复症状。最后，沮丧的弗洛伊德决定寻找别的方法来理解和治疗这种神秘的疾病。其结果是发展出第一个全面的人格理论，并且这个理论至今仍是所有其他理论用来比较的一个标准。
p21.en: After hearing about the work of Salco, curious young doctor Sigmund Freud, 1856-1939 came to Paris to observe the famous hypnotic demonstration of Salco. Freud was encouraged to return to Vienna and was determined to try hypnotic therapy on his patients. But Dr. Freud was dismayed that he found himself unable to hypnotize many people sufficiently deep to replicate the results of Sharco. He did not know that there was a great difference in how people felt about hypnosis, i.e. that there was a difference in the ability of each person to accept the hint of hypnologist. Moreover, even those who disappear under hypnosis usually recover after the end of the hypnosis. Finally, Freud, who is frustrated, has decided to find other ways to understand and treat this mysterious disease. As a result, the first comprehensive personality theory was developed, and it remains a standard for comparison in all other theories.

p22.original: 弗洛伊德创造的新方法被称为精神分析（psychoanalysis）或精神分析理论（psychoanalytic theory）。从技术上讲，精神分析理论是弗洛伊德解释人格和精神障碍的术语，而精神分析指的是他治疗精神障碍的系统方法。然而，在实践中，我们一直很难将弗洛伊德的理论和治疗方法分开。因此，精神分析这个术语经常被用来指代精神分析理论，也被用来表示精神分析方法（Carver & Scheier，2008）。
p22.en: Freud created a new approach known as psychoanalytic (psychoanalysis) or psychoanalytic theory (psychoanalytic theory) which is known as psychoanalytic theory. Technically, the psychoanalytical theory is Freud's term for interpreting personality and mental disorder, whereas psychoanalytical means his systematic approach to the treatment of mental disorder. In practice, however, it has been difficult to separate Freud's theory from his treatment. Thus, the term psychoanalytical is often used to refer to psychoanalytical theory and also to express psychoanalytical methods (Carver & Scheier, 2008).

p23.original: 当学习弗洛伊德的理论时你会发现，有些观点你同意，但有些观点你不赞成。我们建议你保留批判性思维，但同时保持对弗洛伊德的尊重，尊重他在100多年前作为第一个全面人格解释者的创举。在人格、人类发展和精神障碍等方面，他的理论确实是最伟大的理论。
p23.en: When you learn Freud's theory, you find that there are some points you agree with, but some points you don't. We recommend that you retain critical thinking while maintaining respect for Floyd and for his initiative as the first full personality interpreter more than 100 years ago. His theories are indeed the greatest in terms of personality, human development and mental impairment.

p24.original: 弗洛伊德的无意识 无意识（unconscious）是弗洛伊德人格理论的核心。他认为无意识中满是强大的冲动、本能、动机和冲突等内心隐藏的人格驱动力。弗洛伊德说，正常情况下我们不会意识到这一隐藏的精神领域，因为无意识内容太具威胁性且令人焦虑，以至于我们的意识拒绝承认它的存在。即使是最健康的人也是如此。只有使用特殊的精神分析技术，治疗师才能发现这些无意识内容。例如，一个在童年经历过创伤事件的成年人仍然在无意识中保留着这些令人厌恶的记忆。这些记忆可能是性侵犯事件、暴力事件、丧失重要的人或物，以及遭遇致命的事故或自然灾害。当这些记忆试图逃脱无意识状态时，我们才会发现它们。它们可能会伪装成梦境或口误，或者成为精神障碍症状（如抑郁症或恐怖症）。所以，无论精神是否健康，弗洛伊德都坚持认为，我们总在忙于日常事务，从未觉察某些行为背后隐藏的真正动机。
p24.en: Floyd's unconscious and unconscious is at the heart of Freud's personality theory. In his view, the unconscious was filled with powerful impulses, instincts, motivations and internal hidden personality drivers of conflict. Freud said that under normal circumstances we would not be aware of this hidden spiritual domain, because unconscious content is too threatening and worrying to our consciousness refuse to acknowledge its existence. This is true even for the healthiest. Only with special psychoanalyst techniques can the therapist discover these unconscious content. For example, an adult who experienced traumatic events in childhood still retains these repugnant memories unconsciously. These memories may be sexual assault, violence, loss of vital human beings or objects, as well as fatal accidents or natural disasters. We find them when they try to escape unconsciousness. They may be disguised as a dream or an error of mouth, or as symptoms of mental disorders (such as depression or terror). So, whether mental or not, Freud insists that we are always busy with our daily affairs and never see the real motivation behind certain acts.

p25.original: 无意识的内驱力和本能 弗洛伊德告诉我们，无意识中混乱的过程是由我们最基本而隐秘的动机、内驱力和欲望的心理能量所驱动的，类似于精神锅炉里的蒸汽。精神分析理论解释了这种无意识的精神“蒸汽”是如何在我们有意识的思想和行为中以伪装的形式转化和表达出来的。例如，无意识的性冲动（弗洛伊德以希腊充满激情的爱神厄洛斯命名）可以通过性行为直接表达，也可以通过玩笑、工作或创造性追求等间接释放。也许你从未把跳舞、绘画、烹饪、学习或健身等活动视为性行为，但弗洛伊德却认为这些也可能是性行为的一种间接表达！他把厄洛斯产生的能量称为力比多（libido）。这个词来自拉丁语，意思是“欲望”。反过来，作为一种原始的生命力量，性欲能量为其他人格成分提供了能量。
p25.en: Freud tells us that the process of unconscious confusion is driven by our most basic and hidden motivations, internal impulses and mental energy of desire, similar to the steam in a mental boiler. The psychoanalytical theory explains how this unconscious mental “steam” is transformed and expressed in disguise in our conscious thoughts and behaviour. For example, unconscious sexual impulses (named by Freud after the Greek passionate love god Elloz) can be expressed directly through sexual acts, or indirectly by jokes, work or creative pursuits. Perhaps you never considered dancing, painting, cooking, learning or fitness as sexual activity, but Floyd thought that it could also be an indirect expression of sexuality! He called the energy generated by Eros the libido. This term is derived from Latin and means “desired”. In turn, as a primitive force of life, the energy of desire provides energy to other components.

p26.original: 但是，厄洛斯和它的力比多能量并不能完全解释弗洛伊德感兴趣的所有问题。具体来说，它没有解释人类的攻击和破坏行为。它也没有解释那些在噩梦和幻觉中不断重复体验战时创伤的退伍军人的症状。这种痛苦只能用另一种驱力来解释，他将这种驱力命名为桑纳托斯（Thanatos，来自希腊语中的“死亡”一词）。弗洛伊德认为，桑纳托斯是一种无意识的“死亡本能”，它驱动着人类对他人，甚至自己的攻击性和破坏性行为（你可以想想吸烟、强迫性赌博、莽撞驾驶或滥用毒品）。
p26.en: But Erlos and its power over energy does not fully explain all the questions that Freud is interested in. Specifically, it does not explain the attacks and acts of destruction committed by humanity. Nor does it explain the symptoms of veterans who experience wartime trauma repeatedly in nightmares and hallucinations. This suffering can only be explained by another force, which he named Sanatos (Thanatos, the term “death” in Greek). Freud believes that Sanatos is an unconscious “death instinct” that drives humans into offensive and destructive behaviour against others, even against themselves (you can think of smoking, forced gambling, reckless driving or drug abuse).

p27.original: 正常人格的结构 弗洛伊德把人格描绘成由自我、本我和超我的力量组成的三重结构，并且这三种力量一直持续地相互发生冲突。他认为，本我的性驱力和攻击性驱力与超我的道德力量一直在持续发生冲突，而现实的自我则是这场冲突的调停者。
p27.en: The normal personality structure, Freud, portrays the personality as a triple structure of self, me and superpowers, and these three forces continue to clash with each other. In his view, my sexual and offensive drive and my moral superpower have been in constant conflict, and the real self is the mediator in this conflict.

p28.original: 弗洛伊德认为，本我（id）是一个原始的、无意识的仓库，容纳了我们的基本动机、驱力和本能的欲望（包括性和死亡），是人格三重结构的力量源泉。本我像小孩一样，总是冲动行事，追求即时的满足（特别是性、生理和情感上的愉悦），不考虑后果。
p28.en: Freud believes that Ben (id) is a primitive, unconscious warehouse that accommodates our basic motivations, driving forces and instincts (including sex and death) and is a source of strength for the triple human structure. I've always been impulsive, like a child, to pursue instant satisfaction (especially sexual, physical and emotional pleasure), without regard for consequences.

p29.original: 相比之下，超我（superego）像父母（生活在我们内心中的虚拟“父母”），负责从父母、教师、其他权威人物和社会中汲取价值观和道德。超我大致对应我们对“良心”的一般概念。当孩子在父母和其他成年人施加的外部规则的基础上形成一套内部规则时，就会形成超我。它是“应该”和“不应该”的内部声音。超我还包括理想自我，即一个人对自己应该努力成为什么样的人的看法。因而我们能够理解，超我经常反对本我的欲望，因为本我只想做感觉良好的事情，而超我坚持做正确和符合道德的事情。超我成为我们的良心，是我们的道德指南针。因此，当我们遵循它时，我们的自我意识就会增强，社会也会更加诚实地运转。
p29.en: By contrast, superego is responsible for drawing values and ethics from parents, teachers, other authorities and society, like parents (virtual “parents” living in our hearts). More than I can say about our general concept of “conscience”. When a child forms an internal set of rules based on external rules imposed by parents and other adults, it becomes super-me. It is an internal voice of “should” and “should not”. Beyond me, I also include the ideal self, that is, a person's perception of what he or she should be. So we can understand that more than I always object to my desires, because I only want to do things that feel good, and more than I insist on doing the right and ethical things. More than I became our conscience, our moral compass. Thus, when we follow it, our self-consciousness will grow and society will operate more honestly.

p30.original: 在本我与超我的频繁冲突中，理性和逻辑驱动的自我（ego）扮演了裁判的角色。一个完善的自我可以提供一个在某种程度上同时满足两者的解决方案，来解决本我的自私欲望和超我的道德目标之间的冲突。例如，被公认为礼仪典范的美国前总统吉米·卡特（Jimmy Carter）就因为在接受《花花公子》（Playboy）杂志采访时的坦白而惹上了麻烦。他坦白说：“我对很多女性都有欲望，曾在心里多次对她们进行性幻想。”用弗洛伊德的说法，“性幻想”是他的自我在不越过超我界限和道德规范的情况下部分满足本我的方式。当你的本我想逃课去享受阳光，而你的超我却担心成绩下滑时，你的自我可能会为你的内心冲突提供类似的解决方案。在这种情况下，你的自我会做出怎样的妥协呢？在极端情况下，当压力大到自我无法在重大冲突中找到可行的妥协方案时，超我就无法应对新环境的挑战，这可能会导致精神问题（见图10-5）。
p30.en: In this frequent conflict between me and my superiors, rational and logical self (ego) plays the role of referee. A perfect self can provide a solution that meets both to a certain extent and at the same time, to resolve the conflict between this selfish desire and a moral goal beyond my own. For example, Jimmy Carter, former President of the United States, who was recognized as an example of courtesy, was in trouble for his confession in an interview with Playboy. He said, "I have a desire for many women, who have had sexual fantasies many times in my heart. In Freud's words, “sexual fantasy” is the way that his ego meets me in part without going beyond my boundaries and moral norms. Your ego may provide a similar solution to your inner conflict when your mind is too low when I want to skip class and enjoy the sun. In these circumstances, what kind of compromise would your self make? In extreme cases, when pressure is too high to be able to find a viable compromise in a major conflict, it is beyond my ability to meet the challenges of the new environment, which may lead to mental problems (see figure 10-5).

p32.en: Note: In another well-known metaphor, Freud compared the mind to an iceberg, with only a small proportion appearing on the “surface” of consciousness. At the same time, a great deal of unconsciousness lies beneath the “surface” of our consciousness.

p33.original: 精神决定论 精神分析师认为，不存在任何不能解释的东西。根据精神决定论的原则，人类所有的行为都是由我们的心理状态（如无意识的记忆、欲望和冲突）决定的。偶然和巧合在弗洛伊德的字典里是不存在的。你的感受不可避免地会通过你的行为无意识地流露出来，你控制不住。例如，你去上不喜欢的课时会迟到，或者你会拖延和不喜欢的人的会面，你忘记了某个人的生日，或者你说“见到你我很难过，哦，对不起，我的意思是见到你我很高兴”，等等。
p33.en: Mental decision theory psychoanalysts believe that there is nothing to explain. According to the principles of spiritual determination, all human behaviour is determined by our psychological state, such as unconscious memory, desire and conflict. Coincidence and coincidence do not exist in Freud's dictionary. Your feelings will inevitably be revealed through your actions unconsciously, and you can't help it. For example, you'll be late for classes you don't like, or you'll delay meeting people you don't like, you forget someone's birthday, or you'll say, "I'm sorry to see you, oh, I mean I'm happy to see you," and so on.

p34.original: 因此，对弗洛伊德学派的精神分析师来说，一个人所做的每一件事都有潜在的深层心理意义。在治疗中，恐惧和恐怖症等心理症状都是被发现和需要解决的无意识难题的表现。同样，当下意识的言语或行为掩盖内心真实的冲突或欲望时，精神分析师也可能在所谓的弗洛伊德式口误中捕捉到无意识。美国前总统乔治·布什尤其以口误著名。当他想要描述自己的家乡得克萨斯州米德兰多的繁荣时，他说：“真像是喝醉了。”这当然是一个口误，因为布什当时是酒鬼。民主党人也这么做过，泰德·肯尼迪（Ted Kennedy）曾经在一次演讲中想说“最好的和最聪明的”（best and brightest）时，却喊出了“乳房”（breasts）。特别是当他的双手同时做出捧起的动作时，这个口误更加显而易见了！（必须补充的是，那些口误并非一定反映了我们的真实意图。现在的认知心理学家认为，大多数口误都是由于我们负责语言的大脑机制产生了混乱，因此可能与真实的意图没有关系。然而，一些研究也表明，在高焦虑情境下，我们有时会脱口而出我们试图控制的想法。）
p34.en: Thus, for the Freudian school psychoanalysts, everything a person does has a potentially profound psychological significance. In treatment, psychological symptoms such as fear and terror are manifestations of unconscious dilemmas that are detected and need to be addressed. Similarly, when conscious words or behaviour conceal the real conflict or desire of the heart, psychoanalysts may be caught unconsciously in so-called Freudic verbal error. Former United States President George W. Bush is particularly well known for his words. When he wanted to describe the prosperity of his home town of Midrand, Texas, he said, "It's like he's drunk." It was certainly an error, because Bush was an alcoholic. Democrats have done the same, and Ted Kennedy once called "breasses" when he tried to say "best and brightest" in a speech. Especially when his hands are doing the lifting at the same time, the error is even more obvious! (It must be added that those errors do not necessarily reflect our true intentions. Now, cognitive psychologists believe that most of the mistakes are due to confusion caused by the mechanisms of our brain responsible for the language, and therefore may have nothing to do with the real intention. However, some studies have also shown that in high anxiety situations we sometimes come out of our minds as we try to control them. I don't think so.

p35.original: 早期经验对人格发展的影响 当弗洛伊德与他的病人谈论他们的经历时，他开始理解在童年到成年期间人格遵循某种发展模式。他提出，不断出现的性冲动和攻击性冲动促使儿童经历了一系列性心理阶段（psychosexual stage）。在每个阶段，对身体特定部位的刺激都与性快感相关。
p35.en: When Freud talked to his patients about their experiences, he began to understand that personality followed some kind of development pattern from childhood to adulthood. He submits that the emergence of sexual and aggressive impulses prompts children to undergo a series of sexual psychological stages (psychossexual stage). At each stage, the stimulation of a particular part of the body is related to sexual pleasure.

p36.original: 1. 口唇期（oral stage），快乐体验集中在嘴部：哺乳、哭泣、呕吐。
p36.en: 1. Period of oral stage, where the experience of happiness is concentrated on the mouth: breastfeeding, crying, vomiting.

p37.original: 2. 肛门期（anal stage），快感来自身体排泄部位的刺激（这也解释了为什么小孩子会从“狗屎”之类的脏话中获得快乐）。
p37.en: Anal stage, irritation from body excretion (which explains why children get happy from dirty words such as “shit”).

p38.original: 3. 性器期（phallic stage），快感来自“不成熟”的性表达，例如，手淫。
p38.en: Sex stage (phallic stage), pleasure derived from “in maturity” sexual expression, e.g. masturbation.

p39.original: 4. 在安静的潜伏期（latercy stage）后，成年生殖期（genital stage）给那些有幸解决早期阶段冲突的人带来了成熟和心理健康。
p39.en: 4. After a quiet period of incubation, the adult reproductive period brought maturity and mental health to those who had the privilege of resolving the conflict at an early stage.

p40.original: 为什么会有这样一个奇怪的儿童发展理论？ 在弗洛伊德的性心理发展理论中，性别认同和性别角色是他试图解决的问题之一。他想知道，为什么男孩通常会形成男性身份，尽管大多数男孩主要是由母亲抚养长大的？为什么男孩和女孩在长大成人后，会对异性产生性吸引？为什么有些人不属于这种发展模式？
p40.en: Why is there such a strange theory of child development? In Freud's theory of sexual psychological development, gender identity and gender roles are one of the issues he is trying to address. He wondered why boys usually developed male identities, even though most boys were raised mainly by mothers. Why does boys and girls become sexually attractive when they grow up? Why do some people not belong to this model of development?

p41.original: 弗洛伊德对这些问题的回答很令人费解。许多心理学家会说，这是为了附和他的个人观点。他的心理动力学观点不仅忽略了男孩和女孩因社会化方式的不同所带来的外部影响，也忽略了基因差异的可能性，而在弗洛伊德的时代人们对此几乎一无所知。对于男孩来说，他的解释是俄狄浦斯情结（Oedipus complex）。这是一种无意识的冲突，驱使男孩对母亲产生一种不成熟的情爱吸引。例如，你可能听过小男孩说，长大后要和妈妈结婚。随着男孩渡过性心理发展阶段，俄狄浦斯情结冲突的解决需要他将性欲望对象从母亲身上转移到同龄女性身上。与此同时，他对父亲产生了认同感。弗洛伊德以一种类似的方式提出了女孩性心理发展理论。父亲对女孩产生了吸引力，因此女孩与母亲争夺父亲的爱。这种女孩的无意识冲突被称为厄勒克特拉情结（Electra complex），也是根据另一个重要的希腊神话人物命名的。
p41.en: Freud's answers to these questions are inexplicable. Many psychologists would say that this is to echo his personal views. His psychokinetic perspective ignores not only the external impact of different approaches to socialization of boys and girls, but also the possibility of genetic differences, which were almost unknown in Freudian times. For the boy, his explanation was Oedipus complex. This is an unconscious conflict that drives boys to attract an immature love to their mothers. For example, you may have heard the boy say he's going to marry his mother when he grows up. As boys move through the psychosexual stage, the resolution of the Oedipus conflict requires a shift of sexual desire from the mother to the woman of the same age. At the same time, he had developed a sense of identity with his father. Freud presented the theory of girls ' sexual psychological development in a similar way. The father is attractive to the girl, and the girl competes with the mother for the love of the father. This unconscious conflict of the girl is known as the Electra complex, also named after another important Greek mythical figure.

p42.original: 弗洛伊德认为，在性器期，孩子必须通过与同性父母更密切的联系来解决冲突和焦虑。
p42.en: Freud believed that during sexual periods, children must resolve conflicts and anxiety by being more closely linked to same-sex parents.

p43.original: 由于缺乏科学支持，今天大多数心理学家都反对弗洛伊德关于性心理发展的这些假设。然而，我们有必要记住三件事。首先，我们仍然没有完全理解性吸引是如何起作用的。并且，最近美国开始接受同性恋和变性人的生活方式，这鼓励我们对性的本质进行更多的新研究。其次，尽管弗洛伊德关于性心理发展的概念看起来很奇怪，但它在心理学之外仍然有着广泛的影响，尤其是文学领域和法国当前的心理学领域。最后，虽然弗洛伊德关于性心理发展细节的观点可能是错误的，但他关于儿童在各个发展阶段都会取得进步的观点是正确的（Bower，1998b）。这是许多发展心理学家的核心研究主题。
p43.en: In the absence of scientific support, today most psychologists are opposed to Freud's assumptions about sexual psychological development. However, we need to remember three things. First, we still do not fully understand how sexual attraction works. Moreover, the recent beginning of the United States to embrace the way of life of homosexuals and transgender people has encouraged us to undertake more new research on the nature of sex. Secondly, while Freud's concept of sexual psychological development appears strange, it still has a wide influence beyond psychology, especially in the field of literature and the current French psychology. Finally, while Freud's view of the details of sexual psychological development may be incorrect, he is correct in his view that children can make progress at all stages of development (Bower, 1998b). This is a core research theme for many development psychologists.

p44.original: 自我防御 弗洛伊德提出，在处理本我冲动和超我道德之间的冲突时，自我常常依赖于自我防御机制（ego defense mechanisms）。他说，所有这些都在前意识（preconscious）水平上起作用，以减少内部冲突引起的焦虑。在来自本我的轻微压力下，我们可能会采用简单的自我防御，比如幻想（fantasy，如前述的卡特总统的例子）或合理化（rationalization）。但如果无意识的欲望持续不停，自我可能会通过压抑自我来减少后续焦虑。也就是说，将极端的欲望或威胁性记忆隐藏在无意识深处。弗洛伊德称之为“压抑”（repression），并认为它是所有自我防御机制的核心。压抑是许多其他防御机制的基础，这些机制通过扭曲的行为和感知来掩饰我们的真实感受。它会导致不正常的性关系，如果某些人与我们被压抑的或恐惧的目标相似，也会导致我们无法公开地与这些人相处。
p44.en: Freud argued that in dealing with a conflict between my impulse and my super-ethics, self-defense often depends on self-defence mechanisms. All of this, he said, worked at the pre-conscious level to reduce anxiety caused by internal conflicts. We may use simple self-defences, such as fantasy (as in the case of President Carter) or rationalization, under the light pressure of my own. But if unconscious desires persist, self-inflicted self-infliction can reduce subsequent anxiety. In other words, extreme desires or threatening memories are hidden in unconscious depths. Freud called it “pression” and considered it to be the core of all self-defence mechanisms. Repression is the foundation of many other defence mechanisms that hide our true feelings through distorted behaviour and perceptions. It leads to an abnormal sexual relationship, and if some people are similar to our suppressed or feared objectives, it also leads to the inability of us to interact openly with them.

p45.original: 压抑会阻断我们的情感和记忆。因此，儿童可能会压抑对父亲的强烈愤怒情绪，因为如果表现出愤怒，可能会招致严厉的惩罚。同样，男孩会抑制他们对母亲的俄狄浦斯情结。一旦被压抑，这种情感或欲望就不会再被意识到。但是，弗洛伊德说，其实它并没有消失。在无意识的层面，被压抑的情感、欲望和记忆会继续对行为产生影响，但将以不那么直接的方式，也许是伪装成梦、幻想或精神障碍症状。
p45.en: Repression will stifling our emotions and memories. As a result, children may suppress strong anger towards their fathers, as displaying anger may lead to severe punishment. Likewise, boys will suppress their Oedipus attachment to their mother. Once repressed, such feelings or desires will no longer be recognized. But Freud said it didn't actually disappear. At the unconscious level, repressed feelings, desires and memories continue to influence behaviour, but in less direct ways, perhaps disguised as symptoms of dreams, illusions or mental disorders.

p46.original: 作为人类行为的敏锐观察者，弗洛伊德还提出了除幻想、合理化和压抑之外的许多自我防御机制。以下是一些最重要的自我防御机制。
p46.en: Freud, as a keen observer of human behaviour, has also proposed many self-defence mechanisms beyond illusions, rationalizations and repression. The following are some of the most important self-defence mechanisms.

p47.original: 否认（denial）：“我没问题。”这种防御通过简单地否认问题的存在来避免困难的情境。例如，有酗酒问题的人、无法控制愤怒的人，以及做出一些危险行为的人（如无保护措施的性行为）经常会采用否认的自我防御。
p47.en: “I'm fine. Such defence avoids difficult situations by simply denying the existence of problems. For example, denial of self-defence is often used by people with alcohol problems, those who are unable to control anger, and those who commit dangerous behaviour (such as unprotected sex).

p48.original: 合理化（rationalization）：一个感到学业压力大的学生可能会在考试中作弊，并且他会辩解说：“我以前从未作过弊，这次是由于我病得太严重，没法学习。”使用这种防御机制的人会为不被社会接受的行为寻找社会可接受的理由。
p48.en: Rationalizing: A student who feels so stressed that he might cheat on the exam, and he would argue, “I've never cheated before, this time because I'm too sick to learn. Those who use this defence mechanism seek socially acceptable reasons for socially unacceptable behaviour.

p49.original: 反向形成（reaction formation）：反向形成主要见于与自己的无意识欲望不一致的人身上。例如，因自己的同性恋倾向而受到困扰的人，会公开反对同性婚姻，或者通过同时与许多异性约会来证明自己是异性恋者。通过不断地向自己证明无意识欲望并不存在，可以帮助人们远离焦虑。反向形成并不只见于与性相关的行为。一个讨厌领导的人可能对老板非常好，这本质上是通过展示自己喜欢领导来解决本我和超我的冲突（本我可能伤害领导，超我说伤害他人是错误的，领导也是工资的来源）。值得注意的是，个体很难自己识别出这种防御机制。
p49.en: Reverse formation: Reverse formation occurs mainly in persons who are not in line with their own unconscious desires. For example, people who are troubled by their own homophobic tendencies are openly opposed to same-sex marriages or can prove themselves heterosexual by dating many heterosexuals simultaneously. By constantly proving to oneself that unconscious desires do not exist, people can be helped to stay away from anxiety. Reverse formation is not confined to sexual acts. A man who hates leadership may be very good to the boss, and it is essentially to resolve a conflict between me and my super-leader by showing that he likes leadership (which I might hurt, which I say is wrong, and which is the source of salary). It is noteworthy that it is difficult for individuals to identify such defence mechanisms themselves.

p50.original: 转移（displacement）：当领导惹你生气时，你可能会通过对家人大喊大叫或朝墙上扔东西来转移你的愤怒。路怒症是另一个常见的转移的例子。从广义上说，转移指的是将你的反应从真正的痛苦源头转移到更安全的个人或物体上。
p50.en: Transfer: When the leader gets mad at you, you may move your anger by shouting at your family or throwing things at the wall. Road anger is another common case of diversion. In a broad sense, diversion refers to a shift in your response from a real source of suffering to a safer individual or object.

p51.original: 退行（regression）：在压力下，有些人会躲藏；有些人会大哭、发脾气，甚至尿裤子。他们会退回到较早的发展阶段，表现出不成熟的、幼稚的行为。而这些行为是他们小时候应对压力的有效方式。
p51.en: (b) Back off: under pressure, some people would hide; Some people cry, lose their temper, even pee their pants. They will go back to earlier stages of development, showing premature, childish behaviour. These acts are an effective way of dealing with the stress when they are young.

p52.original: 升华（sublimation）：当性冲动或其他不可接受的冲动被抑制时，人们可能会通过激烈的创造性活动、运动或过度的工作来寻求更能被接受的发泄途径。例如，如果你在性方面感到沮丧或愤怒，可能会去健身房锻炼、写日记或打扫房间，将你的能量引导到基本积极的方向上。弗洛伊德推测升华是一些文明进步的主要原因。
p52.en: Promotion: When sexual or other unacceptable impulses are suppressed, people may seek more acceptable outlets through intense creative activity, movement or excessive work. For example, if you feel frustrated or angry about sex, you may go to the gym to exercise, write a diary or clean the room, and direct your energy in a largely positive direction. Freud speculated that the rise in power was the main reason for some of the progress of civilization.

p53.original: 投射（projection）：当某些个人态度或价值观不能被自身完全接受或承认时，其会被指向外部，被视为他人的特征。因此，情侣关系中的一方如果被第三方吸引，可能会指责另一方出轨。又例如，有些人不能接受自己对某些外部群体怀有偏见，就认为其他人是有偏见的，是性别歧视者或种族主义者。从广义上说，人们可能会用投射将自己无意识的欲望和恐惧归咎于他人或某些物体。
p53.en: (c) Projection: When a person's attitude or values cannot be fully accepted or recognized by himself, they are directed to the outside and are considered to be characteristic of others. Thus, if one of the partners in a relationship is attracted to a third party, the other party may be accused of cheating. For example, some people cannot accept that they are biased against certain external groups and consider others to be biased, sexist or racist. Broadly speaking, people may use a projection to attribute their unconscious desires and fears to others or to certain objects.

p54.original: 投射的概念推动了投射测验的发展，在临床心理学中被广泛用于评估人格和精神障碍。现在让我们来介绍一下临床心理学家用来揭示隐藏人格的投射技术。
p54.en: The concept of projection has contributed to the development of the projection test, which is widely used in clinical psychology to assess personality and mental disorders. Now let's introduce the projection techniques used by clinical psychologists to reveal hidden personalities.

p55.original: 投射测验：基于防御机制的诊断
p55.en: Projection tests: diagnosis based on defence mechanisms

p56.original: 你在图10-6中看到了什么？昆虫的头？大脑的核磁共振扫描影像？还是其他内容？诸如此类的意义模糊的图像是投射测验的基础，心理动力学派的临床医生用它们探查患者的内心感受、动机、冲突和欲望。投射测验的假设是，有问题的人会把他们隐藏的动机和冲突投射到这些图像上，就像人们在凝视云朵时可能会在云朵上看到他们想象的物体一样。
p56.en: What do you see in figures 10-6? Insect head? The brain's MRI scan? Or something else? Images of such vague meaning form the basis of the projection tests, which are used by psychodynamic clinicians to detect patients ' inner feelings, motivations, conflicts and desires. The projection test is based on the assumption that people with problems will project their hidden motives and conflicts to these images, just as people may see the objects they imagine on the clouds when they stare at them.

p57.original: 图10-6 类似于罗夏墨迹测验中使用的墨迹
p57.en: Figure 10-6 Similar to the ink marks used in the Rorschach ink test

p58.original: 在最著名的投射测验罗夏墨迹测验（Rorschach Inkblot Techniqne）中，测验材料仅仅是对称的墨迹（就像图10-6所示的那样）。该测验要求研究人员每次展示一幅图像，并问被试：“你看到了什么？这是什么？”研究人员通常用精神分析法来解释被试的反应，在一系列反应中寻找潜在的反应模式，关注其反映出来的无意识的性冲动和攻击性冲动或被压抑的冲突（Erdberg，1990）。
p58.en: In the most famous projection test of Roschach Inkblot Techniqne, the test material was only symmetric ink (as shown in figures 10-6). The test required researchers to present a single image at each time and asked, “What do you see? What's this? “Researchers usually use psychoanalytical methods to explain the response being tested, looking for potential response patterns in a range of responses, and focusing on the unintended and aggressive impulses or repressed conflicts that they reflect (Erdberg, 1990).

p59.original: 罗夏墨迹测验的效果如何？客观研究的结果表明，它在测量人格的个体差异时缺乏一致性和准确性，这很令人失望（Lilienfeld et al.，2010）。批评者还声称，测验的基础是一些不可能被客观验证的概念（如无意识动机）。尽管存在这些批评，但许多临床医生仍然支持罗夏墨迹测验，认为它可以为更广泛的人格评估提供独特的见解（Hibbard，2003）。
p59.en: How's the Rorschach ink test working out? The results of the objective study show a disappointing lack of consistency and accuracy in measuring individual differences in personality (Lilienfeld et al., 2010). Critics also claimed that the tests were based on concepts that could not be objectively validated (e.g. unconscious motivations). Despite these criticisms, many clinicians still support the Rorschach ink test as a unique insight for broader personality assessments (Hibbard, 2003).

p60.original: 相比之下，由哈佛大学心理学家亨利·默里（Henry Murray）编制的主题统觉测验（Thematic Apperaption Test，TAT）是一种更具科学性的投射测验，尤其是在评估成就动机方面。测验材料由类似图10-7的意义模糊的图片组成。被试被要求据此生成一个故事，告知主试图片场景中的人物在做什么，想什么（现在视角），每个事件的原因（过去视角），以及每个事件如何结束（未来视角）。
p60.en: By contrast, the subject epidemiology test prepared by Henry Murray, a psychologist at Harvard University (Thematic Application Test, TAT) is a more scientific projection test, especially in assessing the motivations for achievement. Test material consists of pictures with a vague meaning similar to figure 10-7. It is being asked to produce a story on the basis of which the person in the scene is being told what he or she is trying to do, what he or she is thinking about (the present perspective), the reason for each event (the past perspective) and how each event ends (the future perspective).

p61.original: 根据TAT的投射假设，被试要先理解图片中的元素，然后根据自己的想法、感受、记忆和需求统觉（投射）个人的解释。然后，主试通过解读涉及的心理主题来解释这些反应，例如，攻击性、性需求、成就动机，以及故事中的人物关系。
p61.en: According to TAT's projection assumptions, the elements in the picture are to be understood first, and then interpreted by the individual (projection) on the basis of his own thoughts, feelings, memories and needs. The primary test then explains these responses by interpreting the psychological themes involved, such as aggressiveness, sexual demand, motivation for achievement, and character relationships in the story.

p64.original: 用两种方式描述主题统觉测验中的图像。第一，想象你刚刚获知一些好消息，例如，你赢得了令你高兴的奖品。第二，对同一幅图像，想象你刚刚被一个好朋友拒绝了，或者在一次重要的考试中失败了。
p64.en: Images from the subject overview test are described in two ways. First, imagine you just got some good news, for example, that you won the prize that makes you happy. Secondly, with the same image, imagine you just been rejected by a good friend or failed in a major exam.

p66.original: 注：请花点时间看看这三张图片，然后对每一张图片做一个简短的描述。
p66.en: Note: Please take some time to look at these three pictures and then give a short description of each one.

p68.original: 无论你对弗洛伊德有什么看法，你都必须承认他或许提出了第一个最全面的人格、精神障碍和心理治疗理论。他提出精神分析理论的时候，我们还不了解遗传学和神经递质，大多数精神障碍还没有特别有效的治疗方法，我们也不了解性别认同或性发展的影响因素。他的著作是如此深刻，他的论点是如此令人信服，以至于在人格和精神障碍的理解上，他比任何其他理论家都更具有影响力。他给我们带来了无意识、发展阶段、防御机制的概念，以及行为（甚至包括梦）可能有隐藏意义的观点。此外，在任何提及性都是禁忌的维多利亚时代，他使性问题成为个人发展和精神障碍的中心主题。即使许多心理学家曾经大力反对弗洛伊德的观点，作为人类行为史上最敏锐的观察者，弗洛伊德仍不断获得新的支持（Solms，2004）。他一次又一次地从小事中挖掘出重要的前因后果。就像夏洛克·福尔摩斯是著名的凶案侦探一样，弗洛伊德就像一名精神侦探。几乎每个人都会同意，人们确实会转移自己的攻击性，合理化自己的行为，并且更容易在别人身上看到自己的缺点。
p68.en: Whatever you may think of Freud, you must admit that he has perhaps proposed the first comprehensive theory of personality, mental disorder and psychotherapy. When he introduced the psychoanalytical theory, we were not aware of genetics and neurotransmitters, and most mental disorders did not yet have particularly effective treatments, and we were not aware of the effects of gender identity or sexual development. His writings were so profound that his arguments were so convincing that he was more influential than any other theorist in understanding the personality and the mental disorder. He has brought us the concept of unconsciousness, the stage of development, defence mechanisms and the idea that behaviour (and even dreams) may have hidden meaning. In addition, in the Victorian era, when any reference to sex was taboo, he made the issue of sexuality a central theme for personal development and mental disorders. Even though many psychologists had been strongly opposed to Freud's views, Freud, as the most sensitive observer in the history of human behaviour, had received new support (Solams, 2004). Again and again, he excavates important causes and consequences from minor events. Just like Sherlock Holmes was the famous homicide detective, Floyd was like a psycho. Almost everyone would agree that people did shift their aggressiveness, rationalize their behaviour and see their shortcomings more easily in others.

p69.original: 不科学的弗洛伊德 然而，对弗洛伊德的评价仍然褒贬不一（Azar，1997；McCullough，2001）。最大的问题是，他的许多概念，如“力比多”“肛门期”或“压抑”，都是模糊不清的，缺乏清晰的操作性定义（operational definitions）。这一问题最广为人知的例证之一是关于“恢复”被压抑的童年性虐待记忆的争议。目前没有可信的、可证实的独立证据（通常也不存在）能确定恢复的记忆是真的被压抑了，并且无法排除其是否是由于治疗师、社会工作者或者媒体报道的暗示而被植入的。这些困境使得精神分析理论难以得到科学的评价[3]。
p69.en: The unscientific Freud, however, continues to be rated with mixed approval (Azar 1997; McCullough, 2001. The biggest problem is that many of his concepts, such as “power-to-power” “alcoholic” or “pressure”, are vague and lack clear operational definitions. One of the most widely known examples of this problem is the controversy over “restoring” the repressed memory of sexual abuse in childhood. There is currently no credible and verifiable independent evidence (and usually non-existent) to determine whether the memory of recovery is actually repressed and whether it is implanted as a result of indications from the therapist, social workers or media reports. These dilemmas make it difficult for psychoanalytical theories to receive scientific evaluation [3].

p70.original: 弗洛伊德的坚定拥护者德鲁·韦斯顿（Drew Westen，1998）认为，尽管弗洛伊德从未在意过建立详细的科学案例的问题，但批评者在这一点上的批评可能过于严苛了。韦斯顿说，研究人员已经证实了弗洛伊德的许多基本见解。下面是其中几个已被确认的概念。
p70.en: Drew Westen, a strong supporter of Freud, argued that while Freud had never been concerned about the creation of detailed scientific cases, critics might have been too critical on this point. Weston said that the researchers had confirmed many of Freud's basic insights. Below are a few of the concepts that have been identified.

p71.original: 许多心理过程都是无意识的（虽然无意识的过程不一定完全按照弗洛伊德所设想的工作）。
p71.en: Many psychological processes are unconscious (although they do not necessarily follow the work envisaged by Freud).

p72.original: 人们可以拥有由相互矛盾的动机（有些是有意识的，有些是无意识的）引起的内在冲突，并且同时被驱动做出相互冲突的行为。
p72.en: One can have inherent conflicts caused by conflicting motives (some conscious, others unconscious) and simultaneously be driven to act in conflict.

p73.original: 稳定的人格模式确实从童年时期就开始形成了，部分是由于童年经历，有时是好的影响，有时是坏的影响。
p73.en: A stable personality model does emerge from childhood, partly as a result of childhood experiences, sometimes good, sometimes bad.

p74.original: 此外，在弗洛伊德诞辰150周年之际，一篇有关弗洛伊德影响力的评述表明，弗洛伊德的理论正在神经科学家的关注下重新焕发生机！
p74.en: Moreover, on the 150th anniversary of Freud's birth, a review of Freud's influence shows that Freud's theory is re-energizing with the attention of neuroscientists!

p75.original: “他们发现，如果把弗洛伊德一个世纪前提出的心理学理论整合进来，可能最适合对大脑进行生物学描述。”（Solms，2006）
p75.en: “They found that if the psychological theory that Freud had presented a century ago was integrated, it might be best to give a biological description of the brain. @Solms, 2006

p76.original: 持这种观点的一些科学家正在使用现代神经成像技术来研究弗洛伊德的一些最基本的原则：梦代表未实现的愿望、弗洛伊德的三个心理结构都有神经元基础，而且弗洛伊德的谈话疗法实际上改变了大脑神经元的物理网络（Ayan，2006）。
p76.en: Some scientists with this perspective are using modern neuroimaging techniques to study some of the most basic principles of Freud: dreams represent unfulfilled aspirations, three of Freud's psychological structures have neurons in their base, and Freud's conversation therapy has in fact changed the physical network of brain neurons (Ayan, 2006).

p77.original: 回溯过去但不能预测未来 第二种批评认为，弗洛伊德理论对过去的解释很引人注目，但不能预测未来的反应。也就是说，这可能只是一个后见偏差（hindsight bias）的例子。由于过分强调童年时期的行为起源，精神分析可能忽略了当前生活中的应激源，从而使问题复杂化；而这些应激源可能是精神和行为问题的真正原因。
p77.en: The second criticism that goes back but does not predict the future is that the Freudian theory is remarkable in its interpretation of the past, but it does not predict future reactions. In other words, this may be an example of a posteriori bias. (b) The problem is complicated by the fact that mental analysis may ignore the current sources of stress in life because of the overemphasis on the origins of childhood behaviour; These stressors may be the real cause of mental and behavioural problems.

p78.original: 性别问题 第三种批评指责弗洛伊德轻视女性。尤其令人不满的是，他将女性描绘成不可避免地会产生“阴茎嫉妒”（他认为女性一生中都在无意识地弥补自己的“生理缺陷”）。一个更好的解释是，弗洛伊德的理论只是把他自己的态度和早期男性中心主义的态度投射到女性身上。他无法解释当今时代女性几乎在所有学术领域都表现出色，而男性却表现较差的事实。
p78.en: The third criticism accused Freud of underestimating women. It is particularly disheartening that he portrays women as inevitably producing “punishment” (which, in his view, has unwittingly filled a “physiological defect” in a woman's life). A better explanation is that Freud's theory is merely projecting his own attitude and that of early masculinity towards women. He could not explain the fact that women had performed well in almost all academic fields in the current era, while men had performed poorly.

p79.original: 无意识的新观点 还有一种批评认为，无意识并不像弗洛伊德所认为的那样难以控制（Loftus & Klinger，1992）。从神经科学的情绪研究中得出的新观点来看，大脑有并行的意识通路和无意识通路。无意识通路可以快速地检测到诱发情绪的刺激（想象一下在黑暗的街道上模糊的人影向你靠近时你的“本能”反应），而意识通路下的行为更有目的性和逻辑性（你对自己说，“好吧，保持冷静，行为自然，也许他并不会感觉到你的恐惧”）。这种无意识情绪加工系统的新观点比弗洛伊德想象的无意识（充满愤怒的性欲望和毁灭性死亡愿望）要少了许多恶意和混乱（LeDoux，1996）。
p79.en: There is also criticism that unconsciousness is not as difficult to control as Freud thought (Loftus & Klinger, 1992). From the new perspective of emotional research in neuroscience, the brain has parallel cognitive and unconscious pathways. Ignorant road access detects emotional stimulation quickly (imagining your “intuitive” reaction when people in the dark streets come near you) and conscious road behaviour is more purposeful and logical (you say to yourself, “Okay, stay calm, behave naturally, perhaps he will not feel your fear”). This new view of the unconscious emotional processing system is much less malicious and confusing than Freud's perceived unconsciousness (exhaustible sexual desire and destructive desire to die) (LeDoux, 1996).

p80.original: 弗洛伊德在心理学之外的影响力 尽管有这些批评意见，弗洛伊德的思想还是受到了大众的普遍认可（Adler，2006）。他的吸引力很大程度上归功于他优美的文笔和对性问题的强调。正如弗洛伊德所知，这是每个人都感兴趣的话题！因此，20世纪的艺术和文学作品中出现了大量弗洛伊德理论的形象和符号。他的想法也对市场营销产生了巨大的影响。例如，广告商通过将产品与性感模特联系起来，暗示产品将给其所有者带来性满足。他们还利用弗洛伊德的破坏性本能，提醒我们幸福生活面临的威胁（社会排斥、不规范、英年早逝等），然后提供产品和服务以减少我们的焦虑，使我们重拾希望。
p80.en: Freud's influence beyond psychology, despite these criticisms, is widely accepted (Adler, 2006). His appeal is due in large part to his excellent writing and emphasis on sexuality. As Freud knows, it's a topic of interest to everyone! As a result, the 20th century art and literary works have seen a great deal of Freudian images and symbols. His ideas have also had a huge impact on marketing. For example, by linking products to sexy models, advertisers suggest that products will bring sexual satisfaction to their owners. They also use the destructive instincts of Freud to remind us of the threats to a happy life (social exclusion, irregularities, early death, etc.) and then to offer products and services to reduce our anxiety and restore hope.

p81.original: 汽车的性感销售广告，实际上在西方文化中，所有东西都可以和性感模特关联起来。
p81.en: Sexy advertising of cars, in fact, is associated with sexy models in Western culture.

p82.original: 这类广告主题利用弗洛伊德的概念并非偶然。弗洛伊德的侄子爱德华·伯奈斯（Edward Bernays）被认为是现代公共关系学的先驱，是他最初将弗洛伊德的概念用于公共宣传，使用各种技巧吸引并引导公众注意的。
p82.en: It is no accident that such advertising subjects use the concept of Freud. Edward Bernays, Freud's nephew, was considered a pioneer in modern public relations, having initially used Freud's concept for public information, using techniques to attract and direct public attention.

p83.original: “如果我们理解了群体思维的机制和动机，”他写道，“不就可以在群体不知情的情况下，根据我们的意愿来控制和组织群体吗？最近（第一次世界大战中）的宣传实践证明，至少在某些范围内和某种程度上，这是可能的。”（Bernays，1928）伯奈斯把这种操纵舆论的技术称为“民意操纵法”。
p83.en: “If we understand the mechanisms and motivations of group thinking,” he wrote, “Can we not control and organize groups without their knowledge and according to our will? Recent advocacy practices (in the context of the First World War) have proved that this is possible, at least in some ways and to some extent. Bernays, 1928) describes this media manipulation technique as the “public manipulation method”.

p84.original: 1923年，他写了一本后来成为公共关系学经典的著作，名为《掌控舆论》（Crystallizing Public Opinion）。
p84.en: In 1923, he wrote a book that later became a classic in public relations, called Crystallizing Public Opinion.

p85.original: 弗洛伊德会怎样看待玛丽·卡尔金斯？ 让我们看看弗洛伊德的人格理论是否能帮助我们从新的视角理解玛丽·卡尔金斯，并以此结束我们对弗洛伊德的讨论。精神分析师在解释卡尔金斯的使命感及与体制抗争的意愿时，会先从她的童年经历中去寻找可能塑造其性格的那些经历。
p85.en: What does Floyd think of Mary Carlkins? Let us see if Freud's personality theory will help us to understand Mary Carlkins from a new perspective and thus conclude our discussion of Freud. In explaining Carlkins' sense of purpose and his willingness to fight institutionally, psychoanalysts will first look for experiences that may shape her character from her childhood experience.

p86.original: 卡尔金斯一家人关系特别亲密（Furumoto，1979）。玛丽的母亲夏洛特·卡尔金斯（Charlotte Calkins）的健康状况不断恶化，所以玛丽作为长女承担了许多家务。根据弗洛伊德的观点，即女孩与母亲争夺父亲的关注，这是一个特别有趣的发展经历。玛丽的父亲叫沃尔科特·卡尔金斯（Wolcott Calkins），是公理会牧师。他非常重视教育，在当时女性教育还不受重视的情况下他亲自辅导玛丽。玛丽可能从与父亲的亲密关系中感受到了性吸引，这些性吸引升华为她一生都对工作充满着热情。
p86.en: The Carkins family is particularly close (Furumoto, 1979). Mary's mother Charlotte Calkins' health has deteriorated, so she has taken on a lot of household chores as a eldest daughter. This is a particularly interesting development experience according to Freud's view that girls and mothers compete for their father's concerns. Mary's father, Wolcott Calkins, is a justice priest. He attached great importance to education, and he personally mentored Mary when the education of women was still not valued at that time. Mary may have felt sexual attraction in her intimate relationship with her father, which has given rise to passion for her work throughout her life.

p87.original: 另一件决定性事件是她妹妹的死，这使玛丽极为痛苦。从弗洛伊德的观点来看，妹妹的死可能在无意识中引发了手足争宠（sibling rivalry）的情感冲突。她的本我可能会因为妹妹失败而感到满足，而她的超我则会因为失去妹妹而感到悲伤。精神分析师还可能认为，卡尔金斯升华了她必须承担母亲角色以及在职业生涯中忍受性别歧视而产生的愤怒。当然，就像精神分析通常所做的那样，这些猜测既无法被证实，也不能被证伪，都是后见之明。
p87.en: Another decisive event was the death of her sister, which caused great suffering to Mary. From Freud’s point of view, the death of a sister could have triggered an emotional conflict in the unconscious sibling rivalry. Her sister might be satisfied with her failure, and her super-sweetness would be sad with her loss. Psychoanalysts may also believe that Karlkins has risen to the level of anger that she must assume her mother's role and endure gender discrimination in her career. Of course, as is usually the case with psychoanalytical analysis, these speculations are neither proven nor perjured, but are all illuminating.

p89.original: 弗洛伊德一直是一个富有争议和充满魅力的人物，这也正是他喜欢宣扬的形象（Sulloway，1992）。虽然弗洛伊德吸引了许多追随者，但他却不能容忍任何追随者对精神分析基本原理的批评。因此，就像叛逆的孩子一样，几个同样意志坚定的追随者离开了弗洛伊德，建立了自己的人格、精神障碍和治疗体系。虽然这些新弗洛伊德主义（neo-Freudian）在某些方面背离了弗洛伊德的理论，但它们仍然保留了心理动力学理论的视角。也就是说，它们保留了弗洛伊德的观点，认为人格是一种由无意识能量驱动的过程，但它们对塑造人格的几种无意识动机持不同意见。你也可以在这些有争议的问题上坚持自己的立场：
p89.en: Freud has always been a controversial and charming person, and that is precisely what he likes to promote (Sulloway, 1992). While Floyd attracted many followers, he could not tolerate any criticism of the rationale for psychoanalytic analysis. As a result, several equally determined followers left Freud, like the children of the rebellion, and established their own personality, mental disorder and treatment system. Although these neo-Freudian elements in some respects deviate from Freudian theory, they retain the perspective of psychodynamic theory. In other words, they retain Freud's view that the personality is a process driven by unconscious energy, but they disagree with several of the unintentional motives for the formation of the personality. You can also maintain your position on these controversial issues:

p90.original: 我们的动机主要是性驱力还是社会性动机？
p90.en: Are we motivated primarily by sexual or social motivation?

p91.original: 它们是有意识的还是无意识的？

p92.original: 人格是由过去发生的事件决定的，还是由我们未来的目标决定的？
p92.en: Is personality determined by events of the past or by our future goals?

p93.original: 让我们看看这些新弗洛伊德主义开拓的一些不同方法。
p93.en: Let us look at some of these different approaches that have been pioneered by the new Freudism.

p94.original: 卡尔·荣格：拓展无意识 弗洛伊德有许多追随者，但没有人比卡尔·荣格（Carl Jung）更著名了。他是20世纪前10年里帮助弗洛伊德发展和完善精神分析理论的核心成员之一。弗洛伊德曾经把年轻的荣格视为他的接班人。但是，荣格也在发展自己的理论，并且他越来越无法容忍弗洛伊德的家长式态度（Carver & Scheier，2008）。最终，这种人格冲突（弗洛伊德解释为荣格想要篡夺父亲权威的无意识愿望）导致他们的关系决裂。
p94.en: Karl Jung: Unconscious outreach, Floyd has many followers, but no one is better known than Carl Jung. He was one of the core members in helping Freud develop and refine psychoanalytical theories in the first decade of the twentieth century. Floyd used to see young Jung as his successor. But Jung is also developing his own theory, and he is becoming less and less tolerant of Freud's patriarchal attitude (Carver & Scheier, 2008). Ultimately, this personal conflict (Freud interpreted as the unwitting desire of Jung to usurp the authority of his father) led to the breakdown of their relationship.

p95.original: 对于荣格来说，与弗洛伊德的分歧集中在两个问题上。一方面，荣格认为他的老师过于强调性冲动，忽略了其他无意识的需要和欲望，而这正是荣格的人格理论的核心。尤其是他相信精神性（spirituality）是人类的基本动机，与性冲动同等重要。另一方面，他还对无意识的结构提出了质疑。荣格对无意识的新视角和拓展是其最著名的创新。
p95.en: For Jung, the disagreement with Floyd focused on two issues. On the one hand, Jung believed that his teacher was over-emphasising sexual impulses and neglecting other unconscious needs and desires, which were at the heart of his personality theory. In particular, he believes that mentality is the basic motivation of humanity and is as important as sexual impulses. On the other hand, he questioned the unconscious structure. The new vision and outreach of Jung is its most famous innovation.

p96.original: 荣格理论的原型在艺术作品、文学和电影中比比皆是。这张照片体现了魔术师的原型。美洲原住民传说中的土狼和亚瑟王传说中的梅林同样是原型。
p96.en: The prototype of the Jungo theory is found in works of art, literature and films. This picture reflects the prototype of the magician. The hyena of the Native American legend and Merlin of King Arthur are the same prototypes.

p97.original: 集体无意识 荣格引入了二元无意识代替了弗洛伊德的本我，包括个体无意识（personal unconscious）和集体无意识（collective unconscious）。荣格理论中的个体无意识在本质上与弗洛伊德理论的本我大致相同，但集体无意识却是另一回事，完全是荣格理论的创新。他认为，集体无意识保留了全世界人类共有的本能“记忆”，就像人类拥有共同的基因密码一样。这些集体记忆将无数代人的人类历史联系在一起，形成了原始意象。这些原始意象在世界各地的艺术作品、文学和民间故事中会作为一种原型（archetypes）反复出现（Jung，1936/1959）。
p97.en: The collective unconscious, Jung, introduced the binary unconscious to replace Freud's me, including individual unconscious and collective unconscious. The individual unconscious in the Jungo theory is essentially the same as the Freudian theory itself, but collective unconsciousness is something else, entirely an innovation in the Logo theory. In his view, collective unconsciousness preserved the instinct “memory” common to all human beings worldwide, just as human beings shared the same genetic code. These collective memories have brought together the human history of countless generations and created the original impressions. These primitive images are repeated as a prototype (archetices) in artistic works, literature and folk stories around the world (Jung, 1936/1959).

p98.original: 对于荣格来说，精神障碍的原因不仅包括个体无意识中被压抑的创伤和冲突，也包括我们集体无意识中因难以接受而不能承认的原型。
p98.en: For Eugège, the causes of mental disorders include not only the trauma and conflicts that have been suppressed in an individual's unconsciousness, but also the prototypes that we are unable to recognize because of our collective unconsciousness.

p99.original: 在这些原型记忆中，荣格提出了男性意象（animus）和女性意象（anima），代表了我们人格中的男性化和女性化两方面。其他原型包括母亲、父亲、出生、死亡、英雄、骗子、上帝和自我的一般性概念。在自我的阴暗面隐藏着阴影原型，代表着破坏性和侵略性的倾向（类似于弗洛伊德的死神桑纳托斯），这是我们不愿承认的人格。当你感到愤怒、敌对、嫉妒或猜疑时，你就能发觉自己的阴影原型出现了。
p99.en: In these prototypes, Jung has presented the male and female images of the person (animus) representing both masculinity and feminisation in our personality. Other prototypes include the general concepts of mother, father, birth, death, hero, liar, God and self. It is a person we do not want to recognize by hiding a shadow in the shadows of ourselves, representing destructive and aggressive tendencies (similar to Freud's death, Sanatos). When you feel anger, hostility, jealousy or suspicion, you can see that your shadow prototype appears.

p100.original: 平衡的重要性 荣格的对立原则将每种人格描述为对立倾向之间的平衡，如男性化和女性化。他提出的最著名的对立倾向是外倾性（extraversion）和内倾性（introversion）。外向者将注意指向外部，关注他们周围的人和事，而内向者则专注于自己内心的想法和感受。因此，外倾者与他人和外部事件的关系比他们与自己内在需求的关系更合拍。他们倾向于外向，不受自我意识的影响。相反，内倾者专注于内在体验即自己的想法和感受，这让他们看起来更羞怯、更不善交际。然而，由于他们的内在专注性，他们比外倾者更清楚自己的想法和感受。根据荣格的说法，健康的人格在这些对立的倾向之间保持着平衡，尽管很少有人能在所有人格倾向之间保持完美的平衡。相反，其中某个倾向占主导地位，就产生了人格类型或人格模式的概念。这是个体人格中持久的基本面（Fadiman & Frager，2001）。
p100.en: The principle of equality describes each personality as a balance between opposing tendencies, such as masculinity and feminisation. His most famous opposing tendencies were the extraversion and internalization. Outwarders will focus on the outside and on the people and things around them, while insiders will focus on their thoughts and feelings. As a result, outsiders are more closely related to others and external events than to their inherent needs. They tend to be outward-looking and not influenced by their own consciousness. Instead, the inner circle focuses on the inner experience of its thoughts and feelings, which makes them look more shy and less friendly. However, because of their intrinsic focus, they know better than outsiders what they think and feel. According to Jung, a healthy personality balances these opposing tendencies, although few can strike a perfect balance between all personality tendencies. On the contrary, one of those tendencies predominated, giving rise to the concept of a type or model of personality. This is a fundamental and enduring aspect of the individual personality (Fadiman & Frager, 2001).

p101.original: 对荣格的评价 与弗洛伊德一样，荣格的影响在心理学之外更加明显，特别是在文学和大众媒体上。然而，荣格在三个方面对心理学产生了重大影响。
p101.en: As in Freud, the influence of Jung is more obvious than psychology, especially in literature and the mass media. However, Jung has had a significant impact on psychology in three ways.

p102.original: 1. 他挑战了弗洛伊德，从而为一大批新人格理论开了先河。
p102.en: 1. He challenged Freud, thus spearheading a new set of personality theories.

p103.original: 2. 他关于人格类型的概念，特别是内倾性和外倾性的概念，使他不仅是一个心理动力学理论家，而且也是气质/特质/类型理论的中坚人物。
p103.en: His concept of the type of personality, particularly internal and external dumping, makes him not only a psychodynamic theorist but also a strong figure in the qualitative/genital/type theory.

p104.original: 3. 他对精神性的关注现在引起了更多人的共鸣，尤其是牧师。
p104.en: 3. His concern for mentality has now aroused more resonance, especially among priests.

p105.original: 荣格的理论能给我们提供理解玛丽·卡尔金斯的新视角吗？你怎么认为？
p105.en: Does Jung's theory give us a new perspective on how to understand Mary Carlkins? What do you think?

p106.original: 荣格可能会认为卡尔金斯在男权时代中所取得成功的决心是由她本性中男性化和女性化（即男性意象和女性意象）的冲突激发的。另一个可能的解释是由于玛丽母亲的身体状况不好，她不得不放弃了大部分母性角色，而这也让玛丽否认了自己的母性原型。这也解释了玛丽一生从未结婚以及她在男性主导的学术界努力工作的意愿如此强烈的原因。
p106.en: Jung may think that the determination of Karlkins to succeed in the patriarchal era was inspired by the conflict between masculinity and feminisation in her nature (i.e., male and female images). Another possible explanation was that Mary had to abandon most of her maternal roles because of her poor health, which had led Mary to deny her motherhood prototype. This explains why Mary has never been married in her life and why she is so willing to work hard in male-dominated academia.

p107.original: 荣格理论的现代应用：MBTI 在荣格类型理论的启发下，凯恩琳·库克·布里格斯（Katharine Cook Briggs）和她的女儿伊莎贝尔·布里格斯·迈尔斯（Isabel Briggs Myers）研制了一种测量人格的工具——迈尔斯-布里格斯类型指标（Myers-Briggs Type Indicator，MBTI®；Myers，1998）。这一工具认为，人们需要在几个对立的维度上评估自己的偏好。测验的目的是希望人们能够借助MBTI更好地了解自己和他人，并改善人际关系。迈尔斯编制了一系列题目来评估个体在四个维度上的偏好，这些维度组合在一起会产生16种不同的人格类型。这些类型没有好坏之分，只是体现不同的人格差异，可能会对人们的行为产生不同的影响。
p107.en: Modern application of the Jungo theory: inspired by the Jungo-type theory, Katharine Cook Briggs and her daughter Isabel Briggs Myers developed a tool to measure the personality - Myers-Briggs Type of Indicators (Myers-Brigs Type Indicator, MBTI); Myers, 1998. This tool suggests that people need to assess their preferences on several opposing dimensions. The objective of the tests is to enable people to better understand themselves and others and improve interpersonal relations through MBTI. Miles has developed a series of topics to assess individual preferences in four dimensions, which together produce 16 different personality types. These types are not good or bad, but rather reflect different personality differences, which may have different effects on people's behaviour.

p108.original: 根据荣格的对立原则，MBTI根据以下四个对立维度评估人们的个性倾向（见表10-5）。
p108.en: In accordance with the principle of confrontation of the Angry, MBTI assesses the individuality of the population on the basis of the following four opposing dimensions (see tables 10-5).

p109.original: 表10-5 MBTI评估个性倾向的四个维度
p109.en: Table 10-5 Four Dimensions of Personal Orientation Assessment by MBTI

p110.original: 四个维度各有两种选择，一共可以组成16种不同的类型。这些类型由四个字母标记，例如，ESFP或INTP。当人们使用MBTI时，他们会收到关于自己所属类型及其重要问题的反馈建议。例如，建议夫妻之间尊重和适应彼此的类型差异以改善他们的关系。大学生经常在职业中心参加MBTI测试，之后辅导员利用测试结果帮助他们做出职业选择。在企业中，公司使用该工具来帮助工作团队和管理者更好地了解员工不同的工作风格和偏好。
p110.en: There are two options for each of the four dimensions, which together make up 16 different types. These types are marked by four letters, e.g. ESFP or INTP. When people use MBTI, they receive feedback on their own type and their important issues. For example, it is recommended that couples respect and adapt to their types of differences in order to improve their relationships. University students regularly take MBTI tests at vocational centres, after which counsellors use the results to help them make their career choices. In enterprises, companies use the tool to help teams and managers better understand the different styles and preferences of their employees.

p111.original: MBTI旨在描绘一幅人们如何应对周围世界的多侧面全景图，提供了一个帮助我们理解个体差异是如何影响人们行为的框架。在企业中，MBTI被广泛认为是帮助个人和组织更好地实现个人职业发展的有效工具，例如，做出令人满意的职业选择、获得更好的沟通、有效解决冲突和筛选更有能力的工作团队。许多企业和组织（包括IBM公司、凯萨医疗机构、万豪酒店和美国空军）都将MBTI作为团队建设、领导力和组织发展的一部分。理解人们的偏好能够帮助我们了解什么能够激励个人，什么在消耗个人的精力并导致压力和冲突。学会欣赏他人的不同之处可以让人们采取不同的视角，并以更加包容的态度做出决定（Thompson et al.，2015）。
p111.en: MBTI aims to map how people respond to the multifaceted landscape of the world around them and provides a framework that helps us to understand how individual differences affect people's behaviour. In enterprises, MBTI is widely recognized as an effective tool to help individuals and organizations better achieve individual career development, for example, by making satisfactory career choices, obtaining better communication, effectively resolving conflicts and selecting more capable teams of work. Many enterprises and organizations (including IBM, the Caesar Medical Institute, the Marriott Hotel and the United States Air Force) use MBTI as part of team-building, leadership and organizational development. Understanding people's preferences can help us to understand what inspires individuals, what consumes their energies and leads to pressure and conflict. Learning to appreciate the differences of others can allow people to adopt different perspectives and make decisions in a more inclusive manner (Thompson et al., 2015).

p112.original: 每年约有200万人使用MBTI。20多年来，它一直是一个倍受欢迎的测量工具。尽管MBTI被人们广泛使用，但对其的应用也存在批评的声音。批评者担心的主要问题与MBTI的结构本身有关，即这是一种简单的人为二分法。例如，给一个人贴上外倾者或内倾者的标签，或者贴上思维型或情感型的标签。这样做会迫使每个人都被归入某一个类别中，但是这种分类方法会掩盖事实：“特质确实存在于一个连续体中，而不是一个非此即彼的概念。”这就导致一个只比内倾者多一分的人会和只比外倾者多一分的人被划分为完全不同的类别。实际上，与其说这两个人不同，不如说他们很相似（因为他们只相差两分）。由于测验结构的人为二分法将他们分成了相反的两个类别，这就导致最终对两个相似的人提出的建议有所不同。这样的建议可能不如对两个差异更大的人提出的建议那么有效。因此，从学术的角度来看，对于这些批评者所质疑的MBTI的信度和效度问题，只有时间和实践才能给我们最终的答案。
p112.en: Approximately 2 million people use MBTI every year. It has been a popular measurement tool for more than 20 years. Although MBTI is widely used, there are critical voices about its application. The main concern of critics is related to the structure of MBTI itself, which is a simple artificial dichotomy. For example, a person is labelled as an outsider or an insider, or as a thinker or emotional. This would force everyone to be placed in a particular category, but this classification would obscure the fact that “the quality does exist in a continuum, not a concept that is either different or different. This leads to the classification of a person who has only one point more than the innermost and one point more than the outside. In fact, they are more similar than the two (because they are only two points apart). The fact that the test structure is divided into two opposite categories by the dichotomy of the test structure leads to a difference in the recommendations eventually made for two similar persons. Such a proposal might not be as effective as it would be for the two more disparate persons. Thus, from an academic point of view, only time and practice will give us the final answer to the question of the letter and effectiveness of MBTI, which these critics question.

p113.original: 卡伦·霍妮：心理动力学中的女权主义声音 卡伦·霍妮（Karen Horney）和安娜·弗洛伊德（西格蒙德·弗洛伊德的女儿），代表了精神分析运动早期仅有的女权主义声音。
p113.en: Karen Horny and Anna Freud (the daughter of Sigmund Freud) represent the only feminist voice in the early years of psychoanalytic movements.

p114.original: 霍妮对弗洛伊德提出的俄狄浦斯情结提出了质疑，尤其不赞成他关于女性必须遭受阴茎嫉妒的论断（Horney，1939）。事实上，她提出了子宫嫉妒（womb envy）的概念，暗示男性嫉妒女性在繁衍中的作用。霍妮认为，我们的人格并不是被性冲动驱使，而是被社会需求驱使。她认为，女性应获得与男性同样的机会和权利，并主张男性和女性之间的许多人格差异源于习得的社会角色，并非无意识冲动。她还反驳了弗洛伊德关于人格主要由幼儿时期的经历决定这一观点。霍妮认为，正常的成长包括社会关系和个人潜能的充分发展。然而，这种发展可能会被一种不确定感和孤独感所阻碍，她称之为基本焦虑（basic anxiety），这种焦虑源于孤独感和无意义感，也正是这种基本的焦虑造成了适应问题和精神障碍。
p114.en: Honi questioned Freud's Oedipus complex, and in particular disagreed with his assertion that women must be jealous of their penis (Horney, 1939). In fact, she introduced the concept of uterus jealousy (womb envy), implying that men were jealous of the role of women in reproduction. In Horny's view, our personality is not driven by sexual impulses, but by social needs. In her view, women should be given the same opportunities and rights as men, and it was not an unconscious impulse to argue that many differences between men and women stemmed from acquired social roles. She also refuted Freud's view that personality was largely determined by early childhood experience. According to Horny, normal growth includes social relations and the full development of individual potential. However, this development may be hampered by a sense of uncertainty and isolation, which she calls a basic anxiety (basic anxiety), which stems from a sense of loneliness and lack of meaning, and which is the underlying anxiety that causes problems of adaptation and mental disorders.

p115.original: 神经质需要 当基本焦虑失去控制时，人们会变得神经质。在霍妮（Horney，1942）看来，神经质的人“尽管感到恐惧、无助和孤立，但还是会在无意识中为了应对生活而努力奋斗”（p.40）。这些无意识的奋斗通常会以一个或多个神经质需要（neurotic need）的形式表现出来（见表10-6），这些需要是正常欲望走向极端的情况。霍妮认为，每个人都有这些欲望，但只有当欲望成为一个人生活中强烈的驱动力时，它才会使人变得神经质。
p115.en: Nerves need to become neurotic when the basic anxiety is out of control. According to Horney, 1942, a neurotic person “despite fear, helplessness and isolation, he struggles unconsciously to cope with life” (p.40). These unconscious struggles usually take the form of one or more neeurotic needs (see tables 10-6), which are the extremes of normal desire. Horny believes that everyone has these desires, but it only makes people nervous when it becomes a powerful driving force in a person's life.

p116.original: 表10-6 霍妮的十大神经质需要
p116.en: Table 10-6. Horny's Ten Major Neurotic Needs

p117.original: 霍妮还确定了人们用来处理基本焦虑的三种常见态度和行为模式，分别是接近他人、反对他人和远离他人。
p117.en: Honi has also identified three common attitudes and behavioural patterns that people use to deal with basic anxiety, namely, proximity, opposition and distance.

p118.original: 1. 那些有神经质倾向的人有一种病态的需要，他们需要不断地得到爱和认同。这些人需要他人的帮助和照顾，甚至需要有人为他们而“牺牲”。他们也可以寻找一个可以依赖的人。最终，他们会表现出消极的行为并将自己当作受害者。
p118.en: 1. Those with neuropathic tendencies have a pathological need, and they need constant love and recognition. These people need help and care from others, and even “sacrifice” for them. They can also look for someone they can rely on. Ultimately, they will show negative behaviour and consider themselves victims.

p119.original: 2. 那些反对他人的人通过与他人竞争或攻击来赢得权力和尊重，但这些人会令他人感到恐惧并最终“孤独地站在顶端”。“宁愿被人畏惧，而非被人爱慕”是电影《布朗克斯的故事》（A Bronx Tale）中一个黑手党匪徒的信条。这部电影简明地描述了反对他人者处理基本焦虑的方式。
p119.en: Those who oppose others gain power and respect by competing or attacking others, but they can fear others and eventually “silently stand at the top”. “I would rather be feared than admired” is the credo of a mafia bandit in the film A Bronx Tale. The film succinctly describes the way in which the basic anxiety is dealt with by those who oppose others.

p120.original: 3. 远离他人者为了保护自己免受想象中的伤害和拒绝，很可能会封闭自己，使自己无法获得亲密关系和支持。
p120.en: 3. Those who are far removed from others are likely to close themselves off in order to protect themselves from perceived harm and rejection, leaving them without close ties and support.

p121.original: 对霍妮理论的评价 在职业生涯的早期，卡伦·霍妮的观点在很大程度上被业内忽视了（Monte，1980）。但是在1967年，她的著作《女性心理学》（Feminine Psychology）的出版恰逢其时，使她成为心理学和精神病学中女权主义思想家之一（Horney，1967）。虽然霍妮的理论在当时重新引起了人们的兴趣，但她最终会再次被遗忘吗？她的理论也与其他心理动力学理论有同样的缺陷：科学基础薄弱。只有将她的理论概念转化为可经受科学验证的概念，才能够被科学检验。我们应当明白的是，所有这些人都是伟大的思想家，他们以宏大的方式抽象地阐述人性。当时并没有人引导他们，他们也没有机会接受系统的训练去进行当代实验心理学家提出的所谓科学、严谨的实验。
p121.en: The evaluation of the Horny theory, in the early days of his career, Karen Horne's point of view was largely ignored by the industry. However, in 1967, her book Feminine Psychology was published at a time when she became one of the feminist thinkers in psychology and psychiatry (Horney, 1967). Even though Horne's theory had rekindled interest at that time, would she be forgotten again? Her theory is also as flawed as other psychodynamic theories: the scientific base is weak. Her theoretical concept could only be scientifically tested if it was translated into scientifically verifiable concepts. We should understand that all of these people are great thinkers who speak of humanity in an ambitious manner and abstractally. They were not guided at that time, nor were they given the opportunity to receive systematic training to conduct so-called scientific and rigorous experiments by contemporary experimental psychologists.

p122.original: 霍妮会如何解读玛丽·卡尔金斯？你怎么认为？
p122.en: How would Horny interpret Mary Carlkins? What do you think?

p123.original: 我们推测她会关注卡尔金斯的成就，试图从中确定这些成就是实现其个人潜能的正常动力的结果还是对权力的神经质需要。毋庸置疑，霍妮所处的社会总是赞美有这些需要的男性，而批判有这些需要的女性。霍妮还可能会认为，卡尔金斯的职业认同在很大程度上是由于在那个时代她不得不应对以男性为中心的学术界而形成的。在这种情况下，卡尔金斯不仅利用了童年时来自家庭的支持，还利用了韦尔斯利学院所有女性教师的支持，这些教师成为她成年后的“家庭”支持。从这个角度来看，尽管霍妮被困在充满社会约束和矛盾的网络中，她很可能也会在卡尔金斯身上看到一个强健的人格。
p123.en: We speculate that she will be following the achievements of Carlkins and try to determine whether they are the result of a normal drive to realize their individual potential or the neuro-need for power. It goes without saying that the society in which Horne lives always praises the men who need them and criticizes the women who need them. Horny may also argue that the professional identity of Karlkins was largely the result of the time when she had to deal with male-centred academia. In this context, Carkins has not only used the support of her family as a child, but also of all the female teachers of the Wellsley College, who became “family” support when she reached the age of majority. From this perspective, despite the fact that Horne is trapped in a network of social constraints and contradictions, she is likely to see a strong personality on Carlkins.

p124.original: 其他新弗洛伊德主义理论家 虽然弗洛伊德的思想吸引了很多人加入对精神分析的研究中，但其中一部分人（如卡尔·荣格、卡伦·霍妮）后来也脱离了弗洛伊德，发展出自己的理论和思想。虽然在很大程度上，后弗洛伊德学派的理论家接受了精神决定论和无意识动机的观点。但在某些细节上他们和弗洛伊德的观点不同，特别是关于性、死亡本能和早期生活经历的影响。总之，新弗洛伊德主义者对精神分析理论做出的重要改变可以概括为以下几点。
p124.en: Other neo-Freudist theorists, although Freudian ideas have attracted a lot of people into the study of psychoanalytics, some of them (e.g. Carl Junge, Karen Horne) have since moved away from Freud to develop their theories and ideas. Although, to a large extent, post-Freud theorists have accepted the idea of mental decisiveism and unintentional motivation. However, in some detail they differ from Freud's views, particularly with regard to the impact of sex, death instincts and early life experiences. In sum, the important changes made by the neo-Freudists to the psychoanalytical theory can be summarized as follows.

p125.original: 他们更加强调自我功能，包括自我防御、自我发展，以及作为人格发展主要组成部分的有意识思维，而弗洛伊德主要关注无意识。
p125.en: They placed greater emphasis on self-functionality, including self-defence, self-development, and conscious thinking as a key component of personality development, while Freud focused mainly on unconsciousness.

p126.original: 他们认为，社会因素（文化、家庭和同龄人）在塑造人格的过程中起了重要作用，而弗洛伊德主要关注本能欲望和无意识的冲突。
p126.en: It was argued that social factors (culture, family and peers) played an important role in shaping the personality, while Freud focused mainly on instinctive desires and unconscious conflicts.

p127.original: 他们将人格发展延伸至人的一生，而弗洛伊德主要关注儿童早期的经历。
p127.en: They have extended personality development throughout human life, while Freud has focused on early childhood experiences.

p128.original: 著名的新弗洛伊德主义者爱利克·埃里克森（Erik Erikson）提出了一个精细的人格发展理论，把人的一生分成不同的阶段。这一猜想得到了俄勒冈大学心理学家桑杰·斯里瓦斯塔瓦和他的团队（Sanjay Srivastava et al.，2003）的大量实证支持。他们的数据显示，人在成年后其人格仍会不断变化，20多岁的个体的尽责性水平变得越来越高，30多岁以上的个体的宜人性、热情度、慷慨性和助人性也会随着年龄而增长。埃里克森的观点也受到新一代毕生发展心理学家的赞赏，他们超越了早期只关注婴儿和儿童发展的观点。事实上，他们是目前研究长寿以及如何在生命各个阶段提高生活质量的项目的核心科学家。例如，斯坦福大学的劳拉·卡斯滕森（Laura Carstensen）领导一个长寿促进研发中心，并出版了《光明的未来》（A Bright Future，2011）一书，这本书的副标题是“长寿时代的幸福、健康和财政安全”。
p128.en: The well-known neo-Freudist Erik Erikson has introduced a fine theory of personality development that divides life into different stages. This assumption is supported by extensive empirical evidence from the University of Oregon psychologist, Sanger Srivastava, and his team (Sanjay Srivastava et al., 2003). Their data show that the personality of a person will change as he/she reaches adulthood, that the level of due diligence of individuals in their twenties will grow, and that the humanity, enthusiasm, generosity and assistance of individuals in their thirties will grow with age. Eriksson's views were also appreciated by a new generation of lifelong development psychologists who went beyond the early focus on infant and child development. In fact, they are the core scientists of the current project to study longevity and how to improve quality of life at all stages of life. For example, Laura Carstensen of Stanford University led a long-lived research and development centre and published A Bright Future 2011, subtitled “Happy, healthy and financial security in a long-lived era”.

p129.original: 就这样，后弗洛伊德主义理论家打破了弗洛伊德对人格理论的垄断，为人文主义、存在主义和认知理论家的新观点铺平了道路。
p129.en: Thus, the post-Freudist theorists broke Freud's monopoly on the theory of personality and paved the way for a new vision of humanism, existentialism and cognitive theorists.

p130.original: 10.9 人本主义理论：强调人的潜能和心理健康
p130.en: 10.9 Humanist theory: emphasis on human potential and mental health

p132.original: 考察不同人本主义理论对人格的理解。
p132.en: To examine the understanding of the personality of different humanistic theories.

p133.original: 弗洛伊德主义和新弗洛伊德主义都没有研究“正常人”，他们关注内部冲突和精神障碍，对精神障碍进行了有说服力的解释，但是他们没有提出可用的健康人格理论。人本主义理论对人性乐观的见解取代了前人理论中的阴暗视角恰好满足了这一需求。
p133.en: Neither Freudism nor neo-Freudism studied “normal people”, concerned with internal conflicts and mental disorders, which were convincingly explained, but did not present available theories of healthy personality. An optimistic view of humanism in the humanist theory has replaced the dark perspective in the old man's theory to meet this need.

p134.original: 人本主义心理学家大体上都是乐观的。对他们来说，人格不是由无意识的冲突和对焦虑的防御驱动的，而是由适应、学习、成长和发展的积极需要驱动的。他们保留了动机组成人格核心部分的观点，同时他们也强调动机的积极性，例如，爱、尊重和自我实现。他们认为精神障碍是由不健康的环境造成的，而不是不健康的个人。一旦人们摆脱了消极的环境，例如，消极的自我评价（“我不聪明”），对人格不利的人际关系、工作或职业，那么追寻健康的先天倾向就会引导人们做出改善生活质量的选择。
p134.en: Humanist psychologists are generally optimistic. For them, the personality is driven not by unconscious conflict and defence against anxiety, but by the positive need for adaptation, learning, growth and development. They retain the idea that motivation constitutes the core of the personality, while at the same time emphasizing motivational motivation, such as love, respect and self-fulfilment. They believe that mental disorders are caused by unhealthy environments, not by unhealthy individuals. Once people have moved away from negative environments, such as negative self-evaluation (“I am not smart”) and adverse interpersonal relationships, jobs or occupations, the pursuit of healthy congenital tendencies leads people to make choices to improve their quality of life.

p135.original: 10.9.1 亚伯拉罕·马斯洛和健康人格

p136.original: 亚伯拉罕·马斯洛将人本主义观点称为心理学的“第三力量”，以此将自己的思想与当时主导心理学的精神分析和行为主义理论区分开来。他认为弗洛伊德太执着于关注精神障碍和适应不良，而我们需要一种理论来描绘健康的心理，而不仅仅是停留在没有疾病的层面上。这种理论成为他一生的追求。他在那些生活充实、成就卓越的人身上寻找健康人格的要素，而在这之前从未有人做过这样的研究（Maslow，1968，1970，1971）。
p136.en: Abraham Maslow distinguished his ideas from the psychoanalytical and behavioural theories that dominated the psychology at the time by referring to the humanistic perspective as the “third force” of psychology. He believed that Floyd was too devoted to mental disorders and maladaptation, and that we needed a theory to depict healthy psychology, not just on the level of disease-freeness. This theory became his lifelong quest. He has sought the elements of a healthy personality in those who have lived well and accomplished so well that no one has ever done so before (Maslow, 1968, 1970, 1971).

p137.original: 自我实现者 马斯洛的研究对象包括历史人物亚伯拉罕·林肯和托马斯·杰弗逊，以及与其同时代的几位名人：阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦、阿尔贝特·施韦泽和埃莉诺·罗斯福。在这些人中，马斯洛发现健康的人格专注于超越自身基本需求以外的目标。有些人（如林肯和罗斯福）关注人道主义需求。另一些人（如爱因斯坦）关注对自然世界的理解。他们中的大多数人都投身于自己所热爱的事业中。马斯洛称他们拥有自我实现的人格（self-actualizing personality）。他把这些自我实现者描述为富有创造力、有幽默感、自由行事，但同时又能接纳自己和他人的不足。简而言之，自我实现者是那些可以自由发挥潜力的人。这正是我们应该努力追求并实现的状态。
p137.en: The subjects of the Maaslow study included historical figures Abraham Lincoln and Thomas Jefferson, as well as several of their predecessors: Albert Einstein, Albert Schweizer and Eleanor Roosevelt. Among them, Maslow found that healthy personality focused on objectives beyond his own basic needs. Some (e.g. Lincoln and Roosevelt) are concerned about humanitarian needs. Others (e.g. Einstein) are concerned about understanding the natural world. Most of them are committed to the cause they love. Maslow claims that they have self-fulfilling personality. He described these self-fulfillers as creative, humorous and free, but at the same time able to accept their own and others ' shortcomings. In short, self-realization is for those who are free to develop their potential. That is the state that we should strive to pursue and achieve.

p138.original: 需要层次理论 尽管马斯洛最感兴趣的是健康的、自我实现的人格，但他的需要层次理论（hierarchy of needs）也为适应不良提供了解释。马斯洛认为，我们的需要是按照优先顺序排列的，从生理需要到安全、爱、尊重和自我实现的需要（见图10-8）。如果人们长期不能满足“缺失”的需要，如对爱或尊重的需要，就会产生不适应。而当这种需要得到满足时，就会促使人追求那些促进自身成长和自我实现的目标。事实上，研究显示，低自尊的人在一生中可能会经历更多的恐惧、愤怒或沮丧感，而自我接纳的人则生活得更幸福（Baumeister，1993；Brown，1991）。
p138.en: While Maslow is most interested in a healthy, self-fulfilling personality, his theory of hierarchy of needs also provides an explanation for poor adaptation. According to Maslow, our needs are prioritized, ranging from biological needs to the need for safety, love, respect and self-fulfilment (see figures 10-8). Unadaptation occurs when people are chronically unable to meet “missing” needs, such as the need for love or respect. When this need is met, it prompts people to pursue goals that promote their own growth and self-realization. In fact, research shows that people with low self-esteem may experience more fear, anger or frustration in their lifetime, while self-admissions lead to happier lives (Baumeister, 1993); Brown, 1991.
